1.title: AI Writes More PRs. Who Validates Them? — Ali-Reza Adl-Tabatabai, Sonar
1.author: AI Engineer
1.hook: Agent-based PR validation that automates code review and CI failures, reducing the bottleneck created by AI-generated code at scale.

2.title: How a Remote Company Builds AI Fluency — Em Shreve, Automattic
2.author: AI Engineer
2.hook: Automattic built a two-week in-person program (half workshops, half real project work) to scale AI fluency across 1,400 remote employees, with measurement at 72h/30/90 days and documented outputs (Zendesk connector, support teammate–built tool).

3.title: Why 80% Reliability Isn't Good Enough — Felipe Blanes, Amazon AGI Lab
3.author: AI Engineer
3.hook: The "trust cliff" — 80% reliability feels broken; ~92% feels trustworthy — and a four-step eval flywheel to close the gap between benchmarks and real customer behavior.

1.title: Brains vs Hands: How to Run AI Agents Safely in Production — Viren Baraiya
1.author: AI Engineer
1.hook: LLM plans what happens next; a durable harness executes it deterministically — with approval gates, idempotent steps, and recorded side effects — framed as late-bound sagas compiled at runtime.

1.title: Why AI Agents Deceive Users on Real Tasks | Anastasios Angelopoulos
1.author: MTS
1.hook: Arena's Alignment Index measures AI agent deception, unauthorized actions, and false attribution in real-world agentic workflows; CEO discusses how capable models paradoxically score higher on misalignment metrics and the difference between alignment engineering vs. misalignment science.

2.title: Why MCP Protocol Alone Won't Fix AI Agents | Ayan Barua
2.author: MTS
2.hook: MCP protocol limitations in enterprise AI integration; why real-time translation layers (not unified APIs) solve reliability bottlenecks connecting agents to legacy systems.

3.title: Harvard Professor Explains The Rules of Writing (Steven Pinker Interview)
3.author: David Perell
3.hook: Pinker on writing craft (clarity, examples, visual language, why academic writing fails) and his takes on why AI-generated writing feels bland and how AI would rewrite his own books.

4.title: Sovereign AI Hits $138B as Nations Rush for Compute | Nathan Benaich
4.author: MTS
4.hook: Nathan Benaich covers the State of AI report findings: AI-assisted R&D, long-horizon task execution, robotics' "GPT-2 moment", clinical-stage AI drug discovery, and $138B sovereign AI investment trends. Also touches AI safety and 2027 predictions.

1.title: Why AI Math Breakthroughs Upgrade RSI Timelines | Cheryl Wu
1.author: MTS
1.hook: Cheryl Wu (Elasticity Institute) analyzes OpenAI's math breakthroughs and Tasteval results, discusses measuring recursive self-improvement (RSI) in AI models, differentiates self-sustaining acceleration from intelligence explosion, and examines indicators like researcher headcount and compute reallocation under full automation.

2.title: Why Frontier AI Evals Are Falling Behind | Vincent Chen
2.author: MTS
2.hook: Snorkel AI announces $30M Open Benchmarks Grants program to address evals lagging behind frontier model capabilities; covers three pillars (benchmark funding, red-team program, research fellowship) and discusses benchmark maintenance and AI alignment.

3.title: Why Open Science Is Dying at Frontier AI Labs | Nathan Lambert
3.author: MTS
3.hook: Nathan Lambert discusses Trillium Labs (a new nonprofit for frontier AI research), the collapse of open science at major labs, funding models for decentralized research, and how China's practical approach to AI differs from Western institutional dynamics.

4.title: How to Become a Master Storyteller (Richard Powers Interview)
4.author: David Perell
4.hook: Richard Powers discusses character development, narrative structure, and writing craft across 40+ years and 14 novels — techniques for creating psychologically complex characters and managing tension in fiction.

5.title: Learn Copywriting in 76 Minutes – Harry Dry
5.author: David Perell
5.hook: Copywriting fundamentals (visualization, falsifiability, differentiation) with live ad-writing demos and analysis of famous campaigns (Apple, Economist, Tesla).

6.title: САМОУЧИТЕЛЬ КИНО
6.author: РЕЖУПРАВЛЕНИЕ Жоры Крыжовникова
6.hook: Russian-language lecture on screenwriting pedagogy — how to self-teach film dramaturgy through canonical films, books on craft, and analysis of narrative structure.

1.title: Why AI Agents Won't Take Over Enterprise Yet | Tarek Alaruri
1.author: MTS
1.hook: Tarek Alaruri (Stuut CEO, $52.5M Series B) discusses why enterprise AI agents face adoption friction — human workflow bottlenecks, legacy system integration, and why the autonomous-agent narrative outpaces reality in finance automation.

2.title: Your Camera Roll Is the Ultimate AI Context Layer | Marissa Mayer
2.author: MTS
2.hook: Marissa Mayer discusses Dazzle, a photo-based personal AI assistant that uses camera roll as context for task automation and personalized assistance, with attention to privacy and human-in-the-loop workflows.

3.title: «Движение и мозг: как разные типы физической активности влияют на когнитивное благополучие».
3.author: Библиотека им. Н.А. Некрасова
3.hook: Lecture on the physiological mechanisms linking different types of physical exercise to brain structure, cognitive function, and prevention of age-related cognitive decline and neurodegeneration. Speaker is a neuropsychologist specializing in neurofeedback training.

4.title: Как сильные руководители губят бизнес без стратегии | Сергиенко, McKinsey
4.author: Колосок
4.hook: McKinsey ex-leader on why strong founders/executives become bottlenecks: delegation patterns, fear of strong teams, decision-making in crisis, three leadership models (authoritarian/delegating/consultative), and system thinking vs. heroic management.

5.title: The Deepest Conversation You’ll Ever Watch About Writing (Shafak & Macfarlane Interview)
5.author: David Perell
5.hook: Two literary writers discuss craft elements — emotion-to-words translation, linear vs non-linear structure, rhythm, nature writing, boredom, and reader experience — in a conversational format.

1.title: How RL Creates General Problem Solving | Reflection AI
1.author: MTS
1.hook: Reflection AI CTO discusses Beam (501B parameter model trained on 10.5K GPUs), RL scaling mechanics for general problem-solving, agentic generalization, and how Western labs compete on frontier model velocity.

2.title: General AI Drove a Real Car | Axiom Math
2.author: MTS
2.hook: Researchers from Axiom Math tested frontier LLMs (Astra and others) driving a real Toyota Corolla on a cone course, examining emergent spatial reasoning, latency constraints in physical control loops, and how models bypass safety guardrails.

3.title: 7 убеждений, которые мешали зарабатывать, искать любовь и расти в карьере / Колосок
3.author: Колосок
3.hook: Seven limiting beliefs (unspecified) that the author claims affected earnings, relationships, and career growth; no concrete mechanisms or examples provided in the description.

1.title: Effect Maker Tutorial: Gaming 101 with @cloves_ar
1.author: YouTube Creators
1.hook: Tutorial on YouTube's Effect Maker tool, demonstrating how to build interactive effects (quiz example shown). Covers the creator-facing workflow for a YouTube platform feature.
